name: Automobili Lamborghini Bodacious Kitchen VR Experience
summary: Designed to embody the spirit of the iconic Automobili Lamborghini brand, each Bodacious Kitchen™ is meticulously crafted with Italy's finest materials, delivering top-of-the-line construction and the brand's show-stopping futuristic angles. The sleek marble countertops are designed to stand the test of time with state-of-the-art acid treatment and 4D natural texture, making the stone feel alive yet more resistant than ever.
